summary: The filing reports the exercise and registration of 183,619 new shares under IQM Quantum Computers' ESOP 1 employee stock option plan, with aggregate subscription proceeds of EUR 74,393.80. The exercise period accelerated post-business combination and expired; no options remain outstanding. New shares were registered with the Finnish Trade Register and admitted to trading on Nasdaq Helsinki. This is a routine employee equity plan update, not a special situation.
